kings2.1.p1.b1.text: After the death of Ahab, Moab rebelled against Israel. Now Ahaziah had fallen through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria and injured himself. …

kings2.1.p1.b2.text: Go inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this injury.

kings2.1.p1.b3.text: Go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are on your way to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron?’

kings2.1.p2.b1.text: They replied, “A man came up to meet us and said, ‘… Therefore you will not get up from the bed on which you are lying. You will surely die.’”

kings2.1.p2.b2.text: What sort of man came up to meet you and spoke these words to you?

kings2.1.p2.b3.text: He was a hairy man, … with a leather belt around his waist.

kings2.1.p3.b1.text: Then King Ahaziah sent to Elijah a captain with his company of fifty men. … Elijah, who was sitting on top of a hill, …

kings2.1.p3.b2.text: Man of God, the king declares, ‘Come down!’

kings2.1.p3.b3.text: If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men.

kings2.1.p3.b4.text: And fire came down from heaven and consumed the captain and his fifty men.

kings2.1.p4.b1.text: Man of God, the king declares, ‘Come down at once!’

kings2.1.p4.b2.text: And the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed the captain and his fifty men.

kings2.1.p4.b3.text: Man of God, may my life and the lives of these fifty servants please be precious in your sight.

kings2.1.p5.b1.text: Go down with him. Do not be afraid of him.

kings2.1.p5.b2.text: This is what the LORD says: … Is there really no God in Israel for you to inquire of His word? … Therefore you will not get up from the bed on which you are lying. You will surely die.

kings2.1.p5.b3.text: So Ahaziah died … And since he had no son, Jehoram succeeded him …
